title: Wiki page level access control list bypass in Apache JSPWIKI versions prior to 3.0.1 on all platforms allows an…
description: Apache JSPWIKI versions prior to 3.0.1 contain a vulnerability that allows bypassing wiki page level access control lists. This flaw enables an attacker to circumvent page-level access restrictions by crafting a specially designed wiki page. The issue affects all platforms running vulnerable versions. Users are advised to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which addresses this vulnerability.
